animation.title: &aAnimation
wait.title: &aWait
wait.description:
&7Waits the given amount of seconds
&7before running the next action
path.title: &aPath
path.description:
&7NPC follows the given path
&7(A separate Path will be created
&7from the NPC's current location to
&7the start location of the path)
path.name.title: &ePath Name
path.name.description: &7Set the name of the path the NPC will follow
path.name.input.edit.hover: Click to pre-fill the previous path
path.input.timeout: &cPath input cancelled due to inactivity ({0} second timeout)!
path.speed.title: &eWalk Speed
path.speed.description:
&7Set how fast the NPC will move along the path
&8(&8L/R Click: +/-0.01, Shift+L/R: +/- 0.1)
path.for-all.title: &eVisible for all Players
path.for-all.description:
&7If enabled, the NPC's walking animation
&7will be visible to all players
path.change-real-location.title: &eChange Real Location
path.change-real-location.description:
&7If enabled, the NPC will change it's 
&7'real' location to the end of the path
path.other-world: &cPath is in a different world than the NPC!
path.creating: &7Creating a path from the NPC to the start location of &a{0}&7...
path.failed:
&cFailed to create a path from the NPC to the start location of &e{0}&c!
Please make sure the path is close enough to the NPC and reachable!
path.value.name: &7Path name: &6{0}
path.reversed.title: &eReverse Path
path.reversed.description:
&7Toggle whether the NPC should walk
&7the path in reverse order
variable.title: &aVariable
variable.description:
&7Sets a variable which can be
&7used with $<name> in other actions
&7such as commands
variable.type.title: &eVariable Type:
variable.type.global.description:
&7Global variables are stored server-wide
&7and can be accessed from any NPC
&7or player instance. They persist even
&7after the server restarts.
variable.type.instance.description:
&7Instance variables are specific to
&7each NPC instance. They are saved
&7with the NPC and persist after
&7server restarts.
variable.type.local.description:
&7Local variables are stored in the
&7player's persistent data and are
&7specific to each player. They persist
&7between logins but are only
&7accessible by the same player.
variable.name.title: &eVariable Name
variable.name.input.edit.hover: Click to pre-fill the previous variable name
variable.name.input.timeout: &cVariable Name input cancelled due to inactivity ({0} second timeout)!
variable.name.input.error: &cName invalid! Names must start with a letter or _ and may only contain letters, numbers, and _!
variable.value.title: &eVariable Value
variable.value.input.edit.hover: Click to pre-fill the previous variable value
variable.value.input.timeout: &cVariable Value input cancelled due to inactivity ({0} second timeout)!
runonshow.title: &aRun on NPC Show
runonshow.description:
&7Toggle whether this action runs
&7when the NPC is shown to the player
variable.error.unknown:
&cAn unexpected error occurred while creating variable &7{0}&c:
&c{1}
condition.title: &aCondition
condition.description:
&7If the set condition is true
&7the set action is executed
loop.title: &aLoop
loop.description:
&7Repeats a set of actions multiple times
&7or until a condition is met
loop.for.title: For Loop
loop.while.title: While Loop
loop.while.description:
&7&oRepeats actions as long as
&7&othe specified condition is true
loop.for.start.title: &aStart value
loop.for.value.title: &cLoop value
loop.for.step.title: &eStep value
stop.title: &cStop
stop.description:
&7Stops the execution of the current
&7action sequence immediately
npc.title: &bNPC Option
npc.description:
&7Changes the options of the NPC
&7(for this or all players)
npc.option.change-globally.title: &eChange Globally
npc.option.change-globally.description:
&7Apply these options to all players
&7instead of only this player
